title: Red-Event State Transition Replication
offset_policy: The +8 is frozen from v0.72 and is never fitted or scanned.
boundary_window: For section boundary coordinate k, compare delta[k-58..k-1] with transformed delta[k..k+57]. Exactly 58 transition values appear on each side; the cross-boundary transition is in the before window.
distance: Jensen-Shannon divergence in bits over the 29 transition-value bins, with zero-probability terms omitted.
boundary_eligibility: Use every image-authoritative unsolved red-event boundary having complete +/-58 transition windows inside its section. Preserve separate event identities even when two events share a section coordinate. Section 0.11 is historical discovery/calibration only and can never count as replication.
aggregate: Within each event average its boundary advantages (JS_identity - JS_reflection); within each page average event scores; within each phase average page scores. This equal-page statistic is primary and positive favors reflection.

controls.matched_nonred_boundaries: Replace each boundary independently with a uniformly sampled eligible non-red boundary on the same page; preserve event, boundary, page, and section counts.
controls.randomized_event_positions: Move each whole event uniformly within its page, preserving rune-run length, event count, page and section; derive start/end boundaries unchanged and reject overlap with observed red runs/boundaries.
controls.within_page_rune_permutation: Independently Fisher-Yates permute rune values within every page while retaining page/section lengths and the observed red-event geometry.

control_family_correction: Bonferroni over the three principal null families. Promotion requires adjusted p<=0.05 for every family in discovery and held out.
event_page_multiplicity: No event- or page-level p-values are promoted. Their observed directions are descriptive support for the single phase aggregate, avoiding post-hoc event selection.

promotion.discovery: Independent section 0.6 aggregate must be positive, pass all three Bonferroni-adjusted controls, and have positive page-level effects on at least two distinct pages.
promotion.heldout: Section 0.12 must satisfy the identical unchanged rule and have positive page-level effects on at least two distinct pages.
promotion.replication: Both independent phases must pass; section 0.11 is excluded. A second deterministic run must reproduce the result file byte-for-byte.

v072_exact_audit.status: exact reproduction only; never new evidence

secondary_descriptive.rare_bigram_definition: directed rune bigram occurs at most twice in the complete section
secondary_descriptive.policy: descriptive only; cannot modify or rescue the primary test

binary_red_policy: Red is a binary image-derived glyph channel. JPEG intensity is not treated as numerical evidence.
solved_page_policy: Pages 56 and 57 are extraction controls only; known plaintext is never loaded and their invalid edge windows cannot tune the unsolved test.
page36_guard: The image-authoritative object has five contiguous rows totaling 99 glyphs; 91=7x13 is rejected as intrinsic geometry.
hard_negative_guards: Do not retest or rescue v0.81 literal long-carrier periods 761, 1033, or 3301.
Do not retest or rescue the v0.82 protocol-derived address/index/state-selector family.
Do not use protocol numbers, plaintext, language scores, red intensity, alternative offsets, alternative transforms, optimized windows, or selected favorable events.
